text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Hokko 
Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, after this, do you want to check 
out that new cafe that just opened?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The event company gave me a pair of meal 
vouchers, so I was wondering if you'd like 
to join me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's purely for inspection purposes! 
After all, we must stay on top of the 
latest trends...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up going on an 
"inspection" tour with Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, seasonal flowers on every table... 
How lovely. They really put a lot of 
thought into making it Umastagram-worthy—

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting! Here is your 
"Jeweled Fruit Parfait and Rainbow 
Macarons"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The cherries are sparkling! Wow, they 
really look like jewels...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Your macarons are so colorful too, 
Trainer...! I wonder if this pink one is 
strawberry-flavored...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are you sure?! Th-Then, if you don't 
mind...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *nibble*, hmm, hmm... This is...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's so good! The crispiness on the 
outside and the sweet and tangy strawberry 
cream just melt right in your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmm, pure bliss...!
choice_data_list: It was worth coming all this way!
I'm glad I went out of my way to come!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Wait, ah...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: U-Um... *cough* *ahem*...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah...!! I totally forgot to film!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I already ate one, but even so... could 
you bring the plate a little closer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing our inspection of the 
cafe, we decided to take a break at a 
nearby park."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...The weather is wonderful, isn't it? The 
sunlight is so warm and pleasant—
choice_data_list: I feel like I'm about to doze off.
Looks like you're about to doze off.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Shall we relax here a bit 
longer? We walked a lot today, after all—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *yaaawn*... I'm starting to feel it too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The daily fatigue must have caught up with 
her. So as not to wake Hokko Tarumae, who 
was sleeping peacefully, I quietly pulled 
out a paperback book.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *Zzz*... *zzz*... *mumble*... Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!! Wait, no way, it's already evening?! 
Then, have I been—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so sorry...!! I ended up 
dozing off...!
choice_data_list: Glad to hear you slept well!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry...! I ended up relaxing too 
much... even though I only meant to 
observe.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Man... I feel like things like this have 
been happening a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... Whenever I'm with 
you, Trainer, I just end up... letting my 
guard down, I suppose.
choice_data_list: I'm glad if it helped you unwind!
It's totally fine to be more natural!
I'll join you for an inspection anytime!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
! A breather, is it...? I see, that makes 
sense...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
True, I might have been pushing myself a 
bit too hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since I was able to catch my breath 
properly today, I feel like I'll make a 
lot of progress with my activities again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was fully recharged and 
overflowing with drive. Seeing her work so 
hard, I resolved to keep cheering her on 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! Doing any more than this would be 
too much...! And it would be rude to 
Trainer-san, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a locodol, you must always be conscious 
of the fact that people are watching you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Since we took it easy today, we'll need to 
switch back on properly tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae quickly shifted her mindset 
and looked ahead. Seeing her resolve, I 
decided that I would keep watching over 
her.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really! Thank you so much! Please do it 
again next time...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Coming along with me on the inspection 
like this, and giving me your perspective 
and opinions that I wouldn't have thought 
of.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'd be really happy if you'd continue 
to put up with me from now on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Hokko Tarumae dutifully express 
her gratitude made me want to continue 
supporting her going forward.
